reasons: AC1-2 covered by ac1-*/ac2-* nodes; verify trace shows 24/24 nodes ok=true.
Dual-recipe proof: recipe-baseline.json asserts the buggy values (percentValue 0.44, percentIsClipped true, sliderIsOnStepGrid false) and passes on the unfixed tree, so before-evidence is honest.
Revert-sensitive at both layers: reverting the one-line fix flips three AC1 assertions, and the two new unit tests fail with 22.22 vs 22.
AC1's clipping claim is proven by a real geometry read (scrollWidth 50 > clientWidth 45) plus a capture-helper screenshot, not by DOM presence alone.
All slider input is trusted UI input (ui.press + ui.key_press); the CDP probe is strictly read-only, so no UI value injection.

graph_integrity.reason: Recipe validates under Recipe Protocol v1 (mm-harness run --plan reports pass) and every node is reachable from the entry node through to the terminal end node.

action_contract.reason: Every action is manifest-declared for the extension adapter; the initial pre_conditions top-level field was rejected by --plan and removed rather than guessed at.

ac_coverage.reason: Both ACs bind to ac<N>-* nodes with at least one assertion each; AC1 additionally carries a screenshot. No AC is silently skipped or marked UNTESTABLE.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: AC1 is a visible-copy claim and carries a capture-helper before/after screenshot pair; AC2 is a state claim proven by assert_json plus unit tests, with its image demoted to orientation and omitted from the PR body as redundant.

perps_state_setup.reason: The only precondition is a non-zero Perps tradeable balance, which the live fixture account already satisfies (756.36 USDC), so no synthetic state seeding was needed or faked.

mobile_alignment.reason: Mobile's usePerpsOrderForm.ts:194 carries the identical 2-decimal expression but never renders balancePercent, so the fix targets an Extension-only visible pill without diverging from mobile's internal contract. No toFixed or fiat formatter was introduced for what is a percentage.

good_patterns: dual-recipe baseline asserting buggy values so before-evidence screenshots actually execute
geometry read (scrollWidth vs clientWidth) to prove text clipping instead of asserting DOM presence
revert-check run on the unit tests to confirm they fail without the fix
trusted ui.press + ui.key_press to drive a MUI slider instead of writing values into the DOM
